data: According to its Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025, Microsoft reported diluted earnings per share of $13.64 in fiscal 2025, up from $11.80 in fiscal 2024. That is an increase of about 15.6%. Net income for fiscal 2025 was $101,832 million (about $101.8 billion), up from $88,136 million in fiscal 2024, on revenue of $281,724 million. Diluted weighted average shares outstanding were essentially flat, at 7,465 million in fiscal 2025 versus 7,469 million in fiscal 2024, so the EPS growth came almost entirely from higher net income.
